request.deadline: 18-month funding period with milestones from Q3 2026 through 2027
deliverables: Establish or host a not-for-profit entity and publish technical transition architecture, migration plan, and public usage dashboard in Q3 2026
Hold a board election via on-chain voting under published rules in Q4 2026
Serve all public API traffic for mainnet, preview, and preprod from the new stack and legally transfer Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets in Q1 2027
Open public consultation and publish a long-term sustainability proposal in Q2-Q3 2027
Operate the public API at minimum 99% monthly uptime and publish quarterly technical and budget reports during 2027
request.recipient: Input Output / Blockfrost transition under a community-governed not-for-profit structure, with Intersect/CDH contract and treasury management described
request.what: Transition Blockfrost into a free, community-governed not-for-profit public API/public good for Cardano and fund 18 months of transition and operations.

claims.claim: Blockfrost is described as a hosted REST interface that lets developers read from and interact with Cardano without running their own node.
The proposal states Blockfrost adoption in the Cardano Foundation developer ecosystem survey rose from 39.3% in 2022 to 71.5% in 2025, with links to the survey pages.
The proposal states Blockfrost served 781k unique visitors, more than 1.84 billion API requests, almost 700 requests per second, and over 7 TB of API data last month.
The proposal states that in most Cardano epochs more than 50% of all transactions are submitted through Blockfrost.
The proposal states that more than 100 Icebreakers, described as decentralized Blockfrost operators, have joined the decentralization effort.
The proposal says 90% of Cardano traffic served through the Blockfrost API comes from the free tier and that the commercial model has been difficult for financing this public-good operation.
The proposal commits to transfer Blockfrost source code, trademarks, domain names, and associated assets to the governing not-for-profit entity as part of the transition.
The requested budget is 9,832,979 ADA, calculated as 1,868,266 USD at 0.19 USD per ADA, with allocations for staffing, operations and infrastructure, and legal/accounting.
The proposal says unspent post-transition infrastructure budget will be returned to the treasury and that quarterly reports will include technical data and a budget summary.
The proposal states that delivery will be governed by an off-chain legal contract, milestone acceptance, Intersect delivery assurance, and third-party assurer review.

summary: The document requests 9,832,979 ADA to fund an 18-month transition of Blockfrost from a commercial service into a community-governed not-for-profit public API, with claimed high ecosystem usage, IP transfer, board governance, reporting, and milestone-based assurance.
